summary.text: Ryan Rivers is the Republican candidate for Ohio State Senate District 19 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Scott Charland.
He defeated Beth Lear in the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Ryan Rivers described himself as a Central Ohio business professional who lives in Delaware County with his wife and two daughters.
He listed tax reform, government waste, fraud and abuse, and affordability as his key campaign messages, and said he is passionate about the economy.
